subject: ZenForge MAP: Q4 evaluation milestones & discount request
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@zenforge.ai>, Derek Owens <derek.owens@zenforge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: ZenForge MAP: Q4 evaluation milestones & discount request

Hi Sarah / Derek —

Great to meet yesterday. Attached is the draft mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns the evaluation milestones and expected go-live ramp for Q4. High level:

- Week 1–2: performance validation (latency & throughput tests)
- Week 3–4: integration and security review (SOC2 evidence attached)
- Week 5–8: pilot (2k concurrent tokens/day) + success criteria check
- Month 3 post-pilot: commit to Tier-2 Dedicated pool (ramp to 50k tokens/day by month 6)

You mentioned a commercial ask on the call — a tradeoff between an accelerated Q4 close and a milestone-based credit tied to ramp. Can you confirm the exact discount/credit structure you need to get procurement over the line? If you can send the procurement team’s preferred contract cadence we’ll align the MAP and get internal approvals.

Next steps from our side: I’ll route the final commit request to finance and sales leadership for approval once you lock the target commit size and timing.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: zenforge_map_v1.pdf, pricing_spreadsheet_v3.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_stub.txt
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@zenforge.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenForge MAP: Q4 evaluation milestones & discount request

Thanks Naomi — great summary. Procurement asked for the following to sign by end of Q3:

1) A time-limited commercial incentive: $200,000 total credit applied across the first 6 months of the committed run rate (milestone-driven: 25% at pilot success, remainder over ramp).
2) 12-month minimum commit (starting at the dedicated tier described above).
3) DocuSign route to expedite signatures and a short-term data processing addendum.

Derek and I want to keep the MAP as-is but need the commercial concession to make the numbers work in our Q3 budget. Can you confirm whether that credit is routable through your standard approval chain or if it will need executive clearance?

Appreciate it —
Sarah
VP Product | ZenForge
sarah.lee@zenforge.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ZenForge MAP: Q4 evaluation milestones & discount request

Internal — forwarding ZenForge’s ask. Procurement is requesting a $200k milestone credit tied to the MAP above; deal is for a 12-month committed Dedicated pool. HubSpot: ZEN-4983.

Quick context: ZenForge is strategic in media analytics and has a strong compute profile; if they push to Q3 close we can secure a customer that scales to >$1.2M ARR over 12 months after ramp. Rishi — can you please advise target commercial motion? Markus/Vivek — need clarity on approval limits and whether this requires CFO/CEO sign-off.

Forwarded message quoted below.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: ZenForge MAP: Q4 evaluation milestones & discount request

Naomi — thanks for flagging. A few notes from GTM:

- Revenue motion: If ZenForge hits the commitment and ramp described, the lifetime value is material; we’d like to greenlight an incentive to accelerate close.
- Target ask: $200k credit split across milestones is what procurement asked for — I recommend we try to get to $150k within standard CDS bands and escalate any incremental $50k.
- Approval flow: Finance director (Markus) can approve up to $100k; anything above requires CFO (Vivek) sign-off. If CEO-level approval is needed it should be routed through me with a concise business case.

Marissa — assuming you’ve validated usage profile, can you confirm the ramp assumptions and whether the milestones are realistic? If yes, I’ll prepare the business case for Vivek.

— Rishi
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: ZenForge MAP: Q4 evaluation milestones & discount request

Team — I reviewed the ARR projection and risk-adjusted runway. My position:

- I can approve up to $100k in milestone credits against a signed 12-month commit with standard T&Cs and standard clawback (credits paid only when milestones met).
- The incremental $100k (to reach $200k) exceeds my delegated limit and requires CFO sign-off.
- If Vivek approves, legal will need 48 hrs to run a short exception to the standard pricing addendum and to approve the credit schedule wording.

Vivek — please advise whether you can approve the full $200k given the projected $1.2M ARR potential and proposed clawback. I can cut the finance memo for your signature.

Thanks,
Markus
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@zenforge.ai>, Derek Owens <derek.owens@zenforge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenForge MAP: Q4 evaluation milestones & discount request

Sarah / Derek — thanks for the clear ask and patience while we routed internally. Quick update:

- Approved: $100,000 milestone credit, payable in three tranches tied to pilot success and ramp milestones, contingent on a signed 12-month committed contract and clawback language.
- Escalation: Your incremental request (+$100,000) is currently on the CFO desk for consideration. Vivek is reviewing with legal; he has asked for a one-page business case and the final MAP with precise milestone definitions.
- Next steps for you: please confirm the exact milestone definitions in the attached MAP (I’ve highlighted the acceptance criteria) and confirm whether procurement will accept a staged credit schedule (we proposed 25% at pilot success, 75% split over months 2–6 of ramp).

If we can get the one-pager and signed MAP this week, Rishi will route the CFO memo for final sign-off and we’ll aim for DocuSign by end of Q3.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143
